name: LandingSky – Landing Page Template Library for Elementor
author: LandingSky

sections.description:
LandingSky is an Elementor landing page template library that gives you instant access to 300+ professionally designed landing pages — no design skills required. Browse, preview, and import any landing page template directly into your WordPress site in one click.

Whether you need a lead generation landing page, a sales page, a coming soon page, or a thank-you page — LandingSky has a template for it.

Key Features

  • 300+ landing page templates across dozens of niches and categories
  • One-click import — landing pages are created instantly in your WordPress install
  • Automatic Thank You page — every import creates a linked thank-you page with a pre-wired redirect
  • Free & Pro templates — dozens of free landing page templates available with no license key required
  • My Library — track every import with status, edit links, and quick access to both landing and thank-you pages
  • Access filter — quickly browse Free or Pro-only templates
  • Import options — choose whether to import the thank-you page and/or download media to your Media Library
  • Live pricing table — subscription plans fetched from the API and always up to date
  • Auto-sync — landing page template library stays fresh automatically

Who Is This For?

  • Marketers who need conversion-optimized landing pages fast
  • Agencies building landing pages for multiple clients
  • Freelancers who want a head start on every project
  • Anyone using Elementor who wants professional landing page designs without starting from scratch

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.9 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • Elementor (free)
  • Elementor Pro (for full template compatibility)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the landingsky folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugin manager.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to LandingSky in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Browse the template library and click Import on any template to get started.

For premium templates, enter your license key in LandingSky → Account.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

Elementor (free) is required. Elementor Pro is strongly recommended for full template compatibility — some widget types used in templates are Pro-only.

Can I use the free templates without a license?

Yes. A growing set of templates is available for free with no license key required. Pro templates require a paid plan.

Where do I get a license key?

Visit landingsky.com/pricing to view plans. After purchase, your license key is available in your account at landingsky.com → My Account.

Will imported pages affect my existing content?

No. LandingSky creates new pages — it does not modify any existing pages or templates.

How do I update imported templates?

Templates are snapshots at import time. To get an updated version, simply import the template again — it will create a new page alongside the original.

What external services does this plugin use?

This plugin connects to the LandingSky API at https://landingsky.com to fetch landing page templates and validate license keys. All requests are made server-side from WordPress, never from the visitor’s browser.

The following data is sent to LandingSky:

  • License validation — license key and site URL. Runs on plugin load, cached for up to 12 hours.
  • License deactivation — license key and site URL. Runs when you remove your license key.
  • Template library — license key, plan slug, and search/filter parameters. Results are cached locally.
  • Category list — license key. Cached for 24 hours.
  • Template download — license key, site URL, and template ID. Runs when you import a template.
  • Pricing/plan data — no personal data sent. Cached for 24 hours.

No personal data beyond your site URL and license key is ever transmitted.

Terms of Service: https://landingsky.com/terms — Privacy Policy: https://landingsky.com/privacy

The plugin also loads the Inter font from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com) in the WordPress admin only, never on the front end. Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Is the source code human-readable?

Yes. All JavaScript and CSS shipped with this plugin are original, human-readable source files. No build tools, minifiers, or compilers are used. The files you see in the plugin are the actual source files.
